name: tilttek/loot-tables-bundle
description: tilttek/loot-tables in Symfony: loot boxes sold in an order, committed when placed and drawn once paid, with physical dice at a register and proof kept.

suggest.phil/paged-media: For LootSheetPdf, the production sheet of an order's draws
suggest.phil/ux-kit: For the recipes Card and Badge the buyer's draws are drawn with, through the Symfony UX Toolkit
suggest.symfony/console: For the command that rolls a revealed draw again from its seed and checks it against its commitment
suggest.symfony/form: For PhysicalDiceType, the form of the physical dice at a register, with symfony/options-resolver
suggest.symfony/translation: To translate the form, the components and their messages, in English and French
suggest.symfony/ux-twig-component: For <twig:TilttekLootTables:Commitments>, the buyer's draws, and <twig:TilttekLootTables:PhysicalDice>, the form of the physical dice on the register's page
